'''Otoh Dooku''' was an underwater retreat on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]] created by [[House Dooku]] and located ten [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] from the [[Demurra Trench]]. It was modeled after the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] underwater cities of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] and constructed under the orders of [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Adan Dooku]] who had an appreciation of things of grace as well as of beauty.

In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], [[Duke of Serenno|Duke]] [[Rodas Borgin]] kept the young [[Bron Dooku]] at Otoh Dooku where he was rescued by [[Candra Tymon]] and [[Jahan Cross]].
